title: Sling Siege 弹弓拆塔记
description: A dusk-lit slingshot destruction puzzle! Stretch the band, read the dotted trajectory, and unleash stones, bombs and triple-split shots at wobbly wooden towers, stubborn stone forts and shattering glass halls to flatten every green guard. Wood cracks, stone shrugs, glass explodes — bombs detonate with a shockwave that chain-triggers nearby explosives. Crush enemies under collapsing blocks, blast them off ledges, or drop them from fatal heights. Fewer shots, more stars: 24 hand-built levels across three chapters.
controls: Drag back from the slingshot to aim (dotted line previews the arc), release to fire. R retries instantly, P pauses, M mutes. Use fewer shots than par for 3 stars and unlock later chapters.
author: LightGame
